claim: The NZ Green Party should have delivered 16,000 KiwiBuild houses by now (10/08/2020). They’ve only managed just around 400. And so to promise 5,000 extra houses a year is nothing more than just wishful thinking and is destined to go the same way as KiwiBuild.
evidence: No, this does not match the timeline originally set by Kiwibuild. The target was June 2021 and not August 2020. No, data shows that as of June 2020 452 Kiwibuild homes are complete.
